notes.scope: Aave V3 Ethereum Core borrowers (debt > 0) whose dominant collateral (largest USD among collateral-enabled aToken balances) is WETH. Candidates = unique onBehalfOf of Pool Supply events with reserve in {WETH} (HyperSync, blocks 25412911..26060891), pre-filtered by getUserConfiguration (borrowing any reserve AND a target enabled as collateral). Holders who only received the aToken by transfer are not covered. Candidate window limited to the last 648000 blocks (~90 days, from block 25412901) because the full Supply history is very large; positions whose owner has not supplied WETH in that window are missed.
notes.selfDebtFilter: Excluded 120 WETH-dominant positions (debt $5,973,766, collateral $11,126,297) whose ETH-correlated (reserves 0:WETH, 1:wstETH, 7:cbETH, 9:rETH, 28:weETH, 29:osETH, 31:ETHx, 36:rsETH, 50:tETH, 51:ezETH) debt is >= 10% of their total debt: Kaskad shocks the collateral price with debt fixed in USD, but a WETH price move would move both sides of such a loop. Nothing else is subtracted.
notes.syntheticId: collateralId is the synthetic Kaskad id 7 ("WETH on Ethereum") for every position; the real Aave Ethereum reserve index is ethReserveId (0). debtByAsset keys are Ethereum reserve indices (see ethReserves).
notes.cap: Dropped 216 dust positions with debt < $100 (total debt $3,300) first. Kept the top 300 of 1920 WETH-dominant positions by debtUsd; dropped 1620. Kept positions hold 95.34% of the WETH-dominant debt ($513,204,124 of $538,299,532).
notes.hfModel: hfModel = (collateralUsd + otherCollateralUsd) * ltBps / 1e4 / debtUsd, i.e. the dominant collateral's LT applied to ALL collateral (MVP approximation). hfOnchain = Pool.getUserAccountData.healthFactor / 1e18.
notes.ltRule: ltBps/bonusBps: eMode category values if user eMode > 0 and dominant asset is in the category collateralBitmap (aave-v3-origin GenericLogic/LiquidationLogic), else reserve values. bonusBps is the extra part (10400 -> 400). See totals.ltBreakdown.
notes.totals: totals.collateralUsd/debtUsd are over the kept positions (collateralUsd includes otherCollateralUsd; byAsset collateralUsd = dominant collateral only). totals.reserveSuppliedUsd = WETH aToken totalSupply on Aave Ethereum Core (all suppliers); reserveDebtUsd = 0 (not used by the consumer). totals.all* = before the cap.
notes.depth: depth = Ethereum DEX exit liquidity for WETH (GeckoTerminal reserve_in_usd sum, TVL proxy) with DefiLlama cross-check, same format as data/depth.json entries.

depth.note: Sum of GeckoTerminal reserve_in_usd over 20 Ethereum DEX pool(s) (GeckoTerminal top-pools page(s) 1..3); largest: WETH / USDT 0.3% on uniswap_v3 ($110,109,884). TVL proxy (both sides of each pool), not a slippage curve. Only pools with a USD stablecoin on the other side are counted (read 3 GeckoTerminal page(s)); skipped 40 non-stable pools worth $2,717,135,058 (largest: NEAR / WETH 0.3% @ uniswap_v3 $1,903,760,928; AERO / WETH 0.01% @ uniswap_v3 $401,453,167; OETH / WETH @ curve $57,508,534). WETH unwraps 1:1 to ETH instantly; the liquidator must sell ETH for stablecoins, so the exit is the ETH/stable DEX market (plus CEXs, not counted). DefiLlama (yields.llama.fi) Ethereum DEX pools containing WETH: 1678 pools, $1,523,818,763 total; top: uniswap-v2 WISE-WETH $152,621,832; uniswap-v3 WETH-USDT $110,484,853 (0.3%); uniswap-v3 USDC-WETH $99,357,312 (0.05%); curve-dex CRVUSD-WETH $57,413,982; curve-dex OETH-WETH $57,302,229; uniswap-v3 WBTC-WETH $44,980,004 (0.3%); uniswap-v3 USDC-WETH $42,478,643 (0.3%); uniswap-v3 WBTC-WETH $41,476,716 (0.05%). Non-DEX venues using it (lending / Pendle / vaults; not spot exit liquidity): sky-lending $827,618,783; aave-v3 $762,865,221; sky-lending $723,629,112; sparklend $304,555,167; liquity-v1 $194,759,753; compound-v3 $154,744,271.
